subject: Workplace Skills
title: Managing Your Manager
description: A micro-lesson that makes Managing Your Manager usable.

hook.text: She had a great relationship with her boss. When he left, her new manager had a completely different style.

buildup.text: Your career depends on your manager more than you'd like. They control visibility, projects, and promotion nominations.

discovery.text: Manage up: keep your manager informed, make their priorities your priorities, and never let them be surprised.

twist.text: Managing up isn't being a sycophant. It's strategic communication that keeps you aligned and visible.

climax.text: Schedule regular one-on-ones. Share wins, flag blockers, ask for feedback. Your manager should always know your value.

punchline.text: Keep your manager informed. Surprises kill careers.

quiz.question: What does managing up mean in a career context?
options: Flattering your boss to get better assignments
Strategic communication that keeps you aligned, visible, and surprise-free
Bypassing your manager to talk to senior leaders
